Why complete OCTE?

 To enhance the quality of teaching in the University, Course and Teaching
    Evaluation (CTE) should be conducted as a compulsory exercise.
 An online questionnaire is used for SME USTF OCTE.

Who reads the results?

The information from end-of-course evaluations is considered when
   evaluating the overall teaching. The more students complete the OCTE, the
   more constructive feedback will be taken by courses.

How to complete the USTF OCTE?

Please click on the questionnaire link in the email sent by wj_smeustf to evaluate
   the USTF of the course. (Email Template as below)





Please kindly note that the questionnaire is only for Undergraduate Student
   Teaching Fellows (USTF), and the deadline is Dec 14th, 23:59:00..
